Responsibilities

As a Senior Automation Engineer – Ansible in Infrastructure, Platforms & Operations, you will be accountable for developing automations and enabling self-service of infrastructure engagements system wide.This team is part of a critical initiative launched to support the organization’s 3 year strategic vision to automate / self-service engagements that support entire Federal Reserve System.

What Will Be Expected of You:

  • Work in multiple service automation engagements to automate the high priority tasks, services and end to end workflows across Infrastructure, Platforms & Operations
  • Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end automation solutions using Ansible (playbooks, roles, modules, and workflows) for complex, secure enterprise environments
  • Execute the full software development lifecycle for automation projects, from requirements gathering through deployment, maintenance, support and hand-over
  • Create advanced automation scripts using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell to address complex business requirements and develop custom tools that enhance operational efficiency
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs using modern frameworks (FastAPI, Flask) to orchestrate automation workflows and implement integration patterns that connect diverse enterprise systems
  • Build and optimize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions with CI/CD pipelines, version control best practices, and automated testing frameworks to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Collaborate within Agile and Scaled Agile frameworks with cross-functional teams including infrastructure, security, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions
  • Implement secure coding practices and ensure all automation solutions comply with enterprise security policies and banking regulations where applicable
  • Document solutions, create runbooks, and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Provide technical support for automations, troubleshoot production issues, and participate in on-call rotation as needed
  • Stay current with emerging automation technologies and contribute to automation standards, best practices, and governance frameworks
  • Other duties assigned as necessary

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
  • Extensive experience in end-to-end enterprise software development life cycle experience, automation including maintenance and support
  • Advanced Ansible Expertise: Proven experience developing playbooks, roles, modules and workflows for complex and secure enterprise environments
  • Scripting Proficiency: Advanced skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for custom automation solutions
  • API Development and Integration: Expertise in building RESTful APIs using modern frameworks (FastAPI, Flask) and implementing diverse integration patterns to trigger and orchestrate automation workflows
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks
  • Multi-Platform Knowledge: Strong understanding of Linux/Unix systems, Windows, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent background or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with automation orchestration platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, ARIA ) is a plus
  • Working experience in Agile and Scaled Agile environments
  • Knowledge of secure coding standards and banking environment is a plus
  • US Citizenship is required.
  • Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

If you're a growth-focused marketer with a passion for e-commerce and a knack for driving customer engagement, wed love to hear from you!

raw.description:
Responsibilities

We are seeking a Cloud Architect to join our team of qualified, diverse professionals. The ideal candidate will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of cloud architecture solutions that support a major modernization initiative within the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). This role is responsible for architecting and deploying the Proof‑of‑Concept (POC) cloud environment on CMS AWS, ensuring compliance with CMS security and performance requirements, and guiding the technical execution needed to validate system integration and claims‑matching objectives. The Cloud Architect Lead / Delivery Lead will play a pivotal role in driving successful modernization outcomes by integrating legacy components into a scalable cloud ecosystem and providing expert leadership across technical delivery teams.

Responsibilities:Cloud Architect Lead / Delivery Lead responsibilities shall include, but are not limited to:

  • Leading the cloud architecture design and delivery for the POC phase, deploying and validating a parallel Facets environment on CMS AWS.
  • Developing cloud architecture specifications that support POC validation activities, including the 95% claims match rate target and Tier 1 integration demonstrations.
  • Designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure using AWS best practices and the AWS Well‑Architected Framework.
  • Managing provisioning, configuration, and operational readiness of environments to ensure security, scalability, resiliency, and performance meet CMS AWS requirements.
  • Collaborating with application teams, data teams, security, and CMS stakeholders to support integration of legacy components into the modernized environment.
  • Overseeing technical delivery, including task planning, issues/risk management, and coordination across multi‑disciplinary technical teams.
  • Providing technical leadership, mentorship, and architectural guidance throughout the POC execution.
  • Producing architectural artifacts, diagrams, design documents, and cloud implementation plans aligned with CMS standards and enterprise architecture guidance.
  • Supporting compliance activities including security plans, control documentation, authorization support, and adherence to federal and CMS cloud security requirements.
  • Driving continuous improvement by evaluating new cloud services, automation opportunities, and modernization strategies appropriate to CMS AWS environments.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5 years with BS/BA; or 9 years with a high school diploma.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering solutions on AWS, including use of the AWS Well‑Architected Framework.
  • Experience designing, optimizing, and migrating applications or platforms to AWS, including integration with legacy systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).
  • Experience leading cloud delivery teams or large‑scale modernization efforts within federal or regulated environments.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, identity/access management, networking, encryption, and performance engineering in AWS.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, including leadership and external partners.
  • Knowledge and experience working in Agile environments.
  • U.S. Citizenship or Green Card holder.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or similar cloud certification.
  • Experience supporting CMS programs, CMS AWS environments, or federal healthcare initiatives.
  • Experience working with Facets, claims systems, or healthcare data workflows.
  • Experience designing robust IAM (Identity and Access Management), data encryption, and regulatory frameworks from the ground up.
  • Prior experience in POC development, architecture validation, and performance benchmarking for cloud environments.
  • Understanding of healthcare regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Familiarity with enterprise modernization initiatives involving legacy‑to‑cloud transitions.
  • Experience developing architectural documentation and participating in technical governance or architecture review boards.

raw.excerpt: The Manager will report to a Senior Manager, Commercial Servicing Operations and will oversee a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers overseeing Commercial Real Estate (“CRE”) loans.
raw.description:
The Manager will report to a Senior Manager, Commercial Servicing Operations and will oversee a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers overseeing Commercial Real Estate (“CRE”) loans. This team will include 3-10 direct reports.The Manager will share responsibility for hiring, training, and evaluating existing team members.Additionally, the Manager will handle escalated items for both Investors and Borrowers and is expected to fully understand day-to-day CRE servicing responsibilities as well as multiple product types of CRE loans, including Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CBMS), debt fund, and Single-Family Residential (SFR) loans.Manager will act as a backup point of contact for other business units at Onity for inter-company projects, system enhancements, and other items as they arise.Manager will monitor reports and team performance to proactively identify portfolio risks, employee training opportunities, and engage with staff to ensure that all reporting metrics, contractual obligations, and covenant monitoring requirements are met. Manager may have a portfolio of loans assigned to them for daily workload.Individuals in this role are required to adhere to investor servicing guidelines, internal policies, and procedures.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements

  • Customer Service and Escalation Management:
    • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex Borrower and Investor matters, managing relationships with Borrowers, Investors, Master Servicers, and third-party stakeholders. Resolve servicing issues, facilitate transactions, and deliver a high level of customer service
    • Partner with Asset Management, Special Servicing, Legal, Compliance, and other internal stakeholders to address portfolio challenges, execute complex transactions, support strategic business objectives, and monitor reporting to ensure team performance meets client and contract expectations
  • Team Building:
    • Lead and support a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers, providing adequate ongoing training, guidance, coaching, and oversight to ensure timely and accurate management of loan servicing activities and Borrower requests
    • Monitor team workflows, staffing levels, and servicing activities to ensure Borrower inquiries, consent requests, reserve disbursements, covenant monitoring, and loan administration tasks are completed within established expectations
    • Provide adequate training and direction to team members
    • Lead team building sessions and ongoing meetings with direct reports and broader team to ensure engagement and issue resolution
  • Portfolio Management:
    • Analyze portfolio trends and servicing metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and operational efficiencies, providing recommendations to senior management as appropriate
    • Drive continuous process improvement initiatives by evaluating current procedures, strengthening controls, and implementing best practices to enhance operational effectiveness and portfolio management outcomes
    • Manage portfolio performance monitoring, including watchlist assets, covenant compliance, maturity exposure, and other risk indicators, while escalating concerns and recommending appropriate action when necessary
    • Facilitate and contribute to monthly Watchlist meetings, ensuring asset-level performance concerns, Borrower challenges, and risk mitigation strategies are clearly communicated and documented
    • Assist with the planning and execution of special projects, system enhancements, process implementations, and other department initiatives
    • Prepare and review management reports, portfolio summaries, and team performance metrics to support business planning, resource allocation, and leadership decision-making
    • Strong knowledge of CRE loan participation and insurance coverage requirements
    • Spread and analyze property level financial statements and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets
  • Contract Management:
    • Maintain a thorough understanding of servicing agreements, loan documents, cash management structures, and Investor guidelines to support servicing platform and ensure contractual compliance
    • Ability to understand and interpret contractual requirements and to be able to effectively pass knowledge to team members
    • Ensure compliance with all contract terms by both the Servicing Team and other business units within Onity
    • Work with other business units to provide training and support as necessary in order to ensure contract compliance
    • Review reporting to ensure accurate calculations on client reporting to ensure contract compliance
    • Ability to read, interpret, and teach PSA, TSA, SSA, and Servicing Agreements
  • System Management:
    • Ability to effectively communicate reporting needs to other departments in order to enable them to build out various reports to fit client and Onity needs
    • Strong understanding of system and bank accounting structures and cash flow
    • Demonstrated ability to train reports and other business units on intricacies of servicing system
  • Other Responsibilities and Requirements:
    • Adapt quickly to various requests from multiple sources
    • Prioritize multiple, simultaneous incoming requests, all seen as urgent priority
    • Work with internal business units to develop reports for investors as required
    • Coordinate with internal departments for servicing functions as required.
    • Proactively review and update internal policies and procedures as required
    • Assist with audit and rating agency requests and presentations
    • Lead Commercial team trainings
    • Assist in the preparation of presentations for investors, management, and internal business units
    • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrates positive attitude, adds to a positive team morale, and is eager to take on and learn new things
  • Four year degree from an accredited University preferred or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of CRE loan servicing experience required, 1 – 2 years in a leadership position preferred
  • Full understanding of the full CRE loan life cycle from onboarding through Mortgage Satisfaction.
  • Prior experience with CMBS, RMBS, SFR Portfolio loans, and/or CREFC reporting requirements is a plus
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel, Outlook, CoPilot, and other information processing programs
  • Self-motivated and works independently
  • Ability to perform complex calculations using calculators and systems is required
  • Ability to reason and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately

  • Outstanding communications skills (including verbal, written and listening skills), with an emphasis on strong customer service, professional relationship building skills, conflict resolution, and having difficult conversations

  • Previous experience with REALSynergy servicing system is considered a plus

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

The salary range for this position is expected to be $115,000 to $130,000 per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for annual bonus of 15% based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.

Remote Sales and Use Tax Accountant

FLEXIBLE…ENTREPRENEURIAL…GROWING BUSINESS

TaxConnex is seeking Remote Sales & Use Tax Accountants (Independent Contractors) who will provide our clients with the highest level of customer service and professionalism in the sales and use tax outsourcing market. This is a fully remote and flexible work arrangement, where you decide how many hours you want to work. Apply now if you have a CPA OR Sales & Use Tax Experience required.

Practioner Model: We use a unique “practitioner” model where our Practitioners are independent contractors who maintain flexible hours, working remotely, leveraging the skills and professional designations that they worked hard to obtain and wish to maintain. Practitioners can choose their workload – some choose to work full-time while others choose to work a part-time schedule.

PLEASE NOTE: We appreciate your interest in this position. In order for your resume to be considered, please apply here on Accountingfly, not by contacting TaxConnex directly. It’s an immediate hire opportunity and all resumes will be reviewed quickly.

Responsibilities for a Remote Sales and Use Tax Accountant:

  • Provide sales and use tax services on a monthly basis for clients of TaxConnex.
  • Communicate proactively with Client
  • Respond to Client’s specific sales and use tax questions and requests
  • Monthly translation and import of client sales and use tax data
  • Application of eligible credits
  • Prepare standard and customized reports
  • Review of reports
  • Prepare monthly cash request
  • Communicate cash due from Client to TaxConnex
  • Transmit accurately prepared sales and use tax returns to TaxConnex and jurisdictions in accordance with the Client tax calendar
    reconciliation of Client’s GL
  • Satisfactory resolution of all sales and use tax-related matters (audits, notices, customer inquiries…) on behalf of Client.

Requirements for Remote Sales and Use Tax Accountant:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting
  • Finance or Master’s Degree in Business Administration
  • CPA, CMI, OR 7+ years S&U Tax Compliance Experience
  • Sales tax experience is not necessary as TaxConnex will train the desired Practitioner and provide tax technical support

Required Office Equipment, Software and Insurance:

  • Liability insurance, including errors & omissions and malpractice insurance
  • Dedicated home office workspace
  • High speed internet connection
  • Active office or cellular telephone
  • Laptop with minimum i5 processor, 6GB RAM, 320GB Hard Drive
  • Software including Windows 7 or Windows 8 Professional and MS Office 2010; MS Access 2010 may be required
  • Printer, scanner, FAX machine
  • Daily computer back-up of all folders, files and data related to Company clients and activities

Attributes we look for in a Remote Sales and Use Tax Accountant:

  • Entrepreneurial
  • Not looking for a “job” but looking to work and own something
  • An owner – someone who understands the vendor/vendee relationship with both TaxConnex and the client
  • Detail-oriented
  • Dynamic communication skills – meaning they can manage a conversation not just answer questions politely
  • Long term commitment to the practitioner concept
  • Don’t need benefits
  • Independent
  • Sense of urgency – deadline-driven

KLDiscovery, a leading global provider of electronic discovery, information governance and data recovery services, is currently seeking a Senior Salesforce Engineer position.   

This person will join with other team members to develop CRM (Salesforce) Integrations and website administration, including the software development, testing, and systems automation. Under the supervision of superiors, they will be responsible for researching relevant technologies, developing new software solutions, and creating automation for both platform tests and upgrade procedures. They will also mentor, coach, and train entry and mid-level Salesforce engineers.  

Responsibilities 

  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), Lightning Web Components, Aura components, Visualforce, Screen Flows, custom labels, validation rules, reports, digital experience sites to extend Salesforce to support business requirements. 
  • Assist with each release cycle to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code. 
  • Working with integrated applications such HubSpot, Zenkraft, Vertex, Oracle, DocuSign, Conga, and other custom applications. 
  • Test, refine, and document programs including various types of testing - unit testing, integration testing, system and workflow testing, acceptance testing, regression, performance, exploratory testing, and automation testing in Selenium. 
  • Striving towards coding best practices and data quality. 
  • Perform peer code reviews. 
  • Support bug fixes and implement enhancements to applications in Production. 
  • Create design and user documentation as needed. 
  • Utilize, communicate and enforce coding standards. 
  • Seek and participate in personal development opportunities to maintain a detailed knowledge of industry standards, engineering best practices, and business needs. 
  • Provide Technical Support - bug fixes and implement enhancements to applications in Production within defined SLA. 
  • Adhere to development processes and workflows. 
  • Work in a team or with multiple organizational departments in a dynamic and rapidly changing environment. 
  • Support the Salesforce Administrator on occasion. 
  • Mentor junior level engineers 
  • Possess significant humility, hunger, and people smarts. 
  • Take solutions proposed by others and expand on them to provide the desired outcome. Offer solutions to others. 
  • Awareness of and demonstrate company values, policies and guidelines.  
  • Suggest actions in advance and communicate development needs.  

  • Volunteer for additional activities within their own team. 

Qualifications 

  • Salesforce product knowledge and at least 5 years of Salesforce development experience required. 
  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related scientific field preferred. 
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, Visualforce, Javascript, screen flows, custom labels, validation rules, reports, and digital experience sites required. 
  • Experience architecting custom solutions in Salesforce. 
  • Competency in HTML, XML, Flex, SQL, C#, .NET, MVC, CSS, REST and SOAP-based web services preferred. 
  • Experience developing on other cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services preferred. 
  • Capable of problem identification and resolutions. 
  • Ability to learn from others and adapt to standards. 
  • Ability to express complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing. 
  • Knowledge of client/server and internet systems architectures. 
  • Ability to work in a team or with multiple organizational departments in a dynamic and rapidly changing environment. 
  • Ability to pass a background check upon offer. 

 

This position does not qualify for VISA sponsorship. 

Driving Career Growth, Benefit Excellence: The KLD Advantage

At KLD we invest in employees and their families by placing their wellbeing first. We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. India compensation is based upon the local competitive market.

  • Paid time off, that offers various time off options to help employees maintain a work-life balance, such as Casual, Earned, Sick, Special Leave, and Holidays
  • Ongoing learning and development, a focus on continuous professional development through various training and education reimbursement programs
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn, grow, and achieve the greatest heights…together
  • A surrounding team of mission-driven individuals who genuinely love what they do

  • India compensation is based upon the local competitive market

Who We Are

KLDiscovery provides technology-enabled services and software to help law firms, corporations, and government agencies solve complex data challenges. With offices in 26 locations across 17 countries, KLDiscovery is a global leader in delivering best-in-class data management, information governance, and eDiscovery solutions to support the litigation, regulatory compliance, and internal investigation needs of clients. Our Nebula Ecosystem provides powerful end-to-end eDiscovery and enterprise-grade information governance. Through its global Ontrack data recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, disaster recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction, and tape management.

Job Title: Manager Corporate Events

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

This is a key contributor role with Veeva’s North America marketing team. The role is primarily responsible for food and beverage (F&B) planning and management for large-scale internal and customer events within the U.S.

The successful candidate must be able to focus on the pre-planning and execution side of food and beverage for events, be an operational contributor for all day-to-day processes, manage and reconcile F&B budgets, support execution of tactics, activities, and other details.

Secondary responsibilities will include supporting and/or managing other event planning workstreams as defined by manager.

Must be a team player working collaboratively with marketing and cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

    • Planning and onsite executions of food and beverage management for our two US customer Summits, and internal Field Kickoff (2,500 - 3,500 attendees depending the event)
    • Develops F&B menus for Veeva programs including any ancillary meetings associated with the core program
    • Review attendee projections/estimates and works with Veeva marketing ops team on headcount estimates
    • Responsible for finalizing F&B counts for each program element
    • Submits menus and headcount to venue and works closely with the venue on any special requests
    • Manages venue to Veeva expected service levels defined in our events best practices documentation
    • Manages and maintains Veeva F&B planning spreadsheets and planning docs
    • Ensures flawless execution, quality of service, and timely delivery of all necessary components and materials for each event
    • Short- and long-range planning and proactive management and prioritization of timelines and priorities
    • Developing YoY cost per head analysis against each program component that you manage and each line of business/service offering so that we can make informed decisions on size/location of events
    • Reconciles and closes out final billings with venues
    • Secondary: Support and/or manage other program workstreams as directed

Requirements

    • 5+ years experience in corporate events managing major workstreams
    • 3+ years experience in corporate events managing food and beverage
    • 1+ year experience working on large scale events in a convention center
    • Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
    • Proven excellence participating in cross-team program management
    • Highly organized with superior attention to detail
    • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
    • Proven ability to build relationships with other teams and across all levels
    • Self-starter, proactive, and critical thinker
    • Ability to travel 20-25%

Nice to Have

    • Experience in enterprise software or SaaS

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $70,000 - $100,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

Overview

Are you ready to make a difference in the world of consumer finance? At Attain Finance, we bring over 50 years of expertise in providing credit solutions across the U.S. and Canada. Our deep roots in the financial industry have empowered us to develop convenient, easily accessible financial services that meet our customers' growing needs.

Join a leading consumer credit lender that thrives on innovation and collaboration, where your contributions are truly valued. Our portfolio includes distinguished brands like Cash Money®, LendDirect® and Heights Finance. Each brand is constantly evolving to better serve our customers.

Be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of consumer finance. Apply today and take the next step in your career with Attain Finance!

We're looking for a highly analytical and business-focused Sr. Manager, Digital & Marketing Analytics to lead measurement, reporting, and optimization across our customer acquisition efforts. In this role, you'll help turn complex data into clear insights that drive growth and improve marketing performance across our lending brands.

You'll shape how we measure acquisition effectiveness, identify opportunities throughout the customer journey, develop reporting and analytical models, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence business decisions. You'll partner closely with teams across Marketing, Risk, Finance, Operations, Marketing Technology, and Data Engineering to strengthen our analytics capabilities and support customer growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems with data, working across teams, and driving meaningful impact in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Lead Acquisition Performance Analytics

  • Own acquisition performance reporting and insights across marketing channels.
  • Analyze campaign, funnel, and customer performance to identify growth opportunities.
  • Recommend actions to improve conversion, efficiency, and ROI.

Own Measurement, Tracking & Data Governance

  • Maintain marketing measurement frameworks, KPIs, and tracking standards.
  • Ensure accurate data collection, attribution, and reporting.
  • Partner with Technology and Engineering teams to enhance measurement capabilities.

Develop Attribution & Marketing Effectiveness Models

  • Build and enhance advanced measurement methodologies, including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality testing, and causal measurement frameworks.
  • Measure performance across channels, campaigns, and customer segments.

Lead Funnel Analytics & Customer Journey Optimization

  • Own end-to-end customer acquisition funnel measurement and analysis.
  • Identify key drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with marketing, product, and operations teams to prioritize optimization initiatives and quantify expected business impact.

Drive Experimentation & Insights

  • Design, measure, and evaluate A/B tests, holdout tests, incrementality studies, and other experimentation frameworks.
  • Develop statistically sound approaches for measuring marketing and customer experience improvements.
  • Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that influence strategic decisions and business outcomes.

Build Reporting & Analytics Products

  • Develop and maintain scalable dashboards, scorecards, and self-service analytics tools that empower stakeholders across the organization.
  • Deliver executive-ready presentations and insights that clearly communicate performance, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • Continuously evolve reporting capabilities to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics Enablement

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure reliable, scalable data pipelines and access to high-quality data.
  • Promote analytics best practices and data-driven decision making across the business.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in quantitative field. Master’s degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, customer analytics, or performance measurement, preferably within financial services, fintech, consumer lending, or other customer acquisition-driven businesses.
  • Advanced expertise with web analytics and marketing technology platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, ContentSquare, Google Tag Manager, A/B testing platforms (Optimizely, VWO, etc..) or similar technologies, including implementation and governance.
  • Strong understanding of acquisition marketing channels, including paid search, SEO, affiliates, direct mail, email, display, social media, and other performance marketing channels.
  • Expert-level SQL skills with experience querying, transforming, and analyzing large datasets and with data visualization and business intelligence tools (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, etc..)
  • Strong analytical skills, including forecasting, segmentation, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or leveraging advanced attribution methodologies, including MMM, MTA, incrementality testing, or causal measurement techniques.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evaluating A/B tests and experimentation programs.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations for executives and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders across business functions and geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Python, R, or comparable analytics/programming languages.
  • Experience applying machine learning or AI-driven approaches to forecasting, propensity modeling, customer segmentation, or marketing optimization is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of data warehouse architecture, data modeling, and analytics engineering best practices.

Base Salary: $120,000 - $160,000 USD

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position based on the U.S. average. The actual base salary offered for this full-time position will be determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, skills, knowledge, competencies, and experience.

All full-time salaried employees are eligible for the following benefits, starting on day one: Flexible Paid Time Off Program, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability, and other voluntary coverages. raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for preparing, filing, and following up on all FHA home retention claims timely and accurately according to investor/insurer guidelines. Perform all duties in accordance with the company’s policies and procedures, all US state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the company operates. The approved target starting hourly rate for this position is $23-$26/hour.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Prepare and file all HUD claims timely and accurately according to investor/insurer/CMS guidelines and requirements.

  • Follow up semi-daily on all outstanding claim proceeds.

  • Perform a loan-level reconciliation for all final claim proceeds between the amount claimed, the amount paid, and the outstanding loan indebtedness, including all escrow and corporate advances. Correct error files when identified by cancelling the claim and/or processing a refund request to HUD.

  • Provide posting instructions for all claim proceeds within 24 hours of the receipt of the claim proceeds.

  • Review, follow up, and ensure the timely and accurate completion of all regularly scheduled steps.

  • Input the completion date on the date the action occurs.

  • Obtain approval, and modify the scheduled date to a date in the future when a step in the process cannot be completed.

  • Perform routine follow-up on a daily basis.

  • Keep Supervisor informed of all trends and problems including, but not limited to, claim denials/curtailments, processing delays, etc.

  • Document all servicing, action taken, delays, follow-up, and phone conversations in the system notes

  • Ensure all claim documents are imaged timely.

  • Maintain and control the HUD audit file.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Understanding of the loss mitigation and claims process

  • Excellent written and oral communication, organizational and time management skills. Ability to communicate effectively with all levels both internally and externally

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to problem solve.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork and quality on loan evaluation.

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure and changing priorities

  • Ability to understand opposing points of view on highly complex issues and to negotiate and integrate different viewpoints to serve the best interests of CMS

  • Ability to make decisions that have moderate impact on immediate work unit

  • Ability to organize and prioritize own work schedule on short-term basis (longer than one month)

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide and to record, balance, and check results for accuracy

  • Ability to compose materials such as detailed reports, work-related manuals, publications of limited scope or impact

  • Ability to manage work in order to meet strict deadlines

  • High School Diploma or equivalent work experience; some college preferred.

  • One (1) to two (2) years’ mortgage servicing default experience preferred.

  • Previous FHA claims experience preferred.

Our Company:

Carrington Mortgage Services is part of The Carrington Companies, which provide integrated, full-lifecycle mortgage loan servicing assistance to borrowers and investors, delivering exceptional customer care and programs that support borrowers and their homeownership experience. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: .

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.

For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org.

raw.description:
Senior Electrical Designer | Power & Electrification Division

Philippines | Permanent Work From Home

  • Permanent work-from-home opportunity based in the Philippines, supporting major Australian energy projects.
  • Work across a diverse portfolio of wind, solar, BESS, transmission and HV substation projects.
  • Join a collaborative international team where your technical expertise will directly influence design quality and project outcomes.

The Opportunity

Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division partners with major energy developers and infrastructure clients to deliver large-scale renewable energy and power infrastructure projects across Australia. Based in the Philippines, you will work remotely as part of an integrated project team, contributing to greenfield developments and the upgrade and expansion of existing networks that support Australia's energy transition.

As a Senior Electrical Designer, you will play a key role in the design and delivery of Electrical Balance of Plant (EBOP) projects for wind farms, solar farms and BESS developments, while also supporting HV transmission and distribution infrastructure. You will collaborate virtually with experienced engineers and designers across Australia and the Philippines, gaining exposure to a broad range of technical disciplines and some of Australia's most significant energy projects.

This permanent work-from-home role offers exposure to HV substations, switchyards, underground and overhead reticulation systems, grid connection infrastructure and utility coordination activities. You will contribute to complex technical projects in a supportive team environment, with regular online collaboration across locations and time zones.

Please note: This position is open to candidates residing in the Philippines. The successful candidate will be employed locally through a third-party employment agency and will work exclusively with Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Deliver high-quality electrical design documentation for HV substations, utility infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
  • Develop primary design deliverables including equipment layouts, cable routing, earthing systems, conduit layouts and detailed construction drawings.
  • Support the successful coordination and delivery of multidisciplinary design packages to meet project and client requirements.
  • Contribute to HV and LV power system designs, equipment selection and technical solutions for complex energy infrastructure projects.
  • Collaborate with engineers and project teams to enhance design quality, project delivery and technical outcomes.
  • Help shape the delivery of renewable energy, transmission and power infrastructure projects that support Australia's evolving energy sector.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Designer based in the Philippines who is comfortable working remotely with Australian project teams, solving complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality outcomes across a diverse portfolio.

  • A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
  • 8+ years' experience within a design consultancy environment.
  • Strong experience in HV substation design and detailed design delivery using MicroStation and AutoCAD.
  • Experience delivering electrical engineering designs across renewable energy, transmission, substations, power generation, hydrogen, oil & gas or related energy sectors.
  • Proven capability undertaking LV and HV power generation and distribution systems design, including equipment selection such as transformers, circuit breakers and associated electrical infrastructure.
  • Experience completing HV and LV power system studies including load flow, short circuit, cable sizing, arc flash, discrimination and protection, earthing and harmonics assessments.
  • Proficiency using electrical modelling software such as ETAP, EMTP or PSCAD.
  • Strong understanding of relevant Australian Standards, including AS 2067, IEEE 80, AS/NZS 1768, AS 3000, AS 3008, IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-border team.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian projects or working to Australian Standards is highly regarded.

It would be great if you also have experience in High Voltage and Low Voltage Switchboard design in accordance with AS 61439 and exposure to instrumentation and control systems.

Why Fyfe?

Fyfe is an Australian multidisciplinary consultancy with more than 700 people across engineering, environment, planning and surveying. We partner with clients across the Energy & Resources and Property & Infrastructure sectors to deliver high-quality, commercially pragmatic solutions with a strong focus on client service and project delivery

Joining Fyfe from the Philippines means becoming a valued member of an international team, not an outsourced support function. Your expertise will have a genuine impact as you work on meaningful Australian energy projects and collaborate directly with experienced professionals across multiple disciplines.

Reasons to join Fyfe:

  • Permanent work-from-home arrangement from anywhere in the Philippines.
  • Direct involvement in major Australian renewable energy and power infrastructure projects.
  • Regular collaboration with experienced colleagues across Australia and the Philippines.
  • Competitive locally aligned remuneration and support for ongoing professional development.
  • An inclusive, technically strong workplace that values contribution, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

The Manager will report to a Senior Manager, Commercial Servicing Operations and will oversee a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers overseeing Commercial Real Estate (“CRE”) loans. This team will include 3-10 direct reports.The Manager will share responsibility for hiring, training, and evaluating existing team members.Additionally, the Manager will handle escalated items for both Investors and Borrowers and is expected to fully understand day-to-day CRE servicing responsibilities as well as multiple product types of CRE loans, including Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CBMS), debt fund, and Single-Family Residential (SFR) loans.Manager will act as a backup point of contact for other business units at Onity for inter-company projects, system enhancements, and other items as they arise.Manager will monitor reports and team performance to proactively identify portfolio risks, employee training opportunities, and engage with staff to ensure that all reporting metrics, contractual obligations, and covenant monitoring requirements are met. Manager may have a portfolio of loans assigned to them for daily workload.Individuals in this role are required to adhere to investor servicing guidelines, internal policies, and procedures.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements

  • Customer Service and Escalation Management:
    • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex Borrower and Investor matters, managing relationships with Borrowers, Investors, Master Servicers, and third-party stakeholders. Resolve servicing issues, facilitate transactions, and deliver a high level of customer service
    • Partner with Asset Management, Special Servicing, Legal, Compliance, and other internal stakeholders to address portfolio challenges, execute complex transactions, support strategic business objectives, and monitor reporting to ensure team performance meets client and contract expectations
  • Team Building:
    • Lead and support a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers, providing adequate ongoing training, guidance, coaching, and oversight to ensure timely and accurate management of loan servicing activities and Borrower requests
    • Monitor team workflows, staffing levels, and servicing activities to ensure Borrower inquiries, consent requests, reserve disbursements, covenant monitoring, and loan administration tasks are completed within established expectations
    • Provide adequate training and direction to team members
    • Lead team building sessions and ongoing meetings with direct reports and broader team to ensure engagement and issue resolution
  • Portfolio Management:
    • Analyze portfolio trends and servicing metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and operational efficiencies, providing recommendations to senior management as appropriate
    • Drive continuous process improvement initiatives by evaluating current procedures, strengthening controls, and implementing best practices to enhance operational effectiveness and portfolio management outcomes
    • Manage portfolio performance monitoring, including watchlist assets, covenant compliance, maturity exposure, and other risk indicators, while escalating concerns and recommending appropriate action when necessary
    • Facilitate and contribute to monthly Watchlist meetings, ensuring asset-level performance concerns, Borrower challenges, and risk mitigation strategies are clearly communicated and documented
    • Assist with the planning and execution of special projects, system enhancements, process implementations, and other department initiatives
    • Prepare and review management reports, portfolio summaries, and team performance metrics to support business planning, resource allocation, and leadership decision-making
    • Strong knowledge of CRE loan participation and insurance coverage requirements
    • Spread and analyze property level financial statements and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets
  • Contract Management:
    • Maintain a thorough understanding of servicing agreements, loan documents, cash management structures, and Investor guidelines to support servicing platform and ensure contractual compliance
    • Ability to understand and interpret contractual requirements and to be able to effectively pass knowledge to team members
    • Ensure compliance with all contract terms by both the Servicing Team and other business units within Onity
    • Work with other business units to provide training and support as necessary in order to ensure contract compliance
    • Review reporting to ensure accurate calculations on client reporting to ensure contract compliance
    • Ability to read, interpret, and teach PSA, TSA, SSA, and Servicing Agreements
  • System Management:
    • Ability to effectively communicate reporting needs to other departments in order to enable them to build out various reports to fit client and Onity needs
    • Strong understanding of system and bank accounting structures and cash flow
    • Demonstrated ability to train reports and other business units on intricacies of servicing system
  • Other Responsibilities and Requirements:
    • Adapt quickly to various requests from multiple sources
    • Prioritize multiple, simultaneous incoming requests, all seen as urgent priority
    • Work with internal business units to develop reports for investors as required
    • Coordinate with internal departments for servicing functions as required.
    • Proactively review and update internal policies and procedures as required
    • Assist with audit and rating agency requests and presentations
    • Lead Commercial team trainings
    • Assist in the preparation of presentations for investors, management, and internal business units
    • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrates positive attitude, adds to a positive team morale, and is eager to take on and learn new things
  • Four year degree from an accredited University preferred or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of CRE loan servicing experience required, 1 – 2 years in a leadership position preferred
  • Full understanding of the full CRE loan life cycle from onboarding through Mortgage Satisfaction.
  • Prior experience with CMBS, RMBS, SFR Portfolio loans, and/or CREFC reporting requirements is a plus
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel, Outlook, CoPilot, and other information processing programs
  • Self-motivated and works independently
  • Ability to perform complex calculations using calculators and systems is required
  • Ability to reason and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately

  • Outstanding communications skills (including verbal, written and listening skills), with an emphasis on strong customer service, professional relationship building skills, conflict resolution, and having difficult conversations

  • Previous experience with REALSynergy servicing system is considered a plus

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

The salary range for this position is expected to be $115,000 to $130,000 per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for annual bonus of 15% based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

You'll shape how we measure acquisition effectiveness, identify opportunities throughout the customer journey, develop reporting and analytical models, and provide data-driven recommendations that influence business decisions. You'll partner closely with teams across Marketing, Risk, Finance, Operations, Marketing Technology, and Data Engineering to strengthen our analytics capabilities and support customer growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems with data, working across teams, and driving meaningful impact in a fast-paced environment.

Develop Attribution & Marketing Effectiveness Models

Lead Funnel Analytics & Customer Journey Optimization

  • Own end-to-end customer acquisition funnel measurement and analysis.
  • Identify key drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with marketing, product, and operations teams to prioritize optimization initiatives and quantify expected business impact.

Drive Experimentation & Insights

  • Design, measure, and evaluate A/B tests, holdout tests, incrementality studies, and other experimentation frameworks.
  • Develop statistically sound approaches for measuring marketing and customer experience improvements.
  • Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that influence strategic decisions and business outcomes.

Build Reporting & Analytics Products

  • Develop and maintain scalable dashboards, scorecards, and self-service analytics tools that empower stakeholders across the organization.
  • Deliver executive-ready presentations and insights that clearly communicate performance, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • Continuously evolve reporting capabilities to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics Enablement

  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure reliable, scalable data pipelines and access to high-quality data.
  • Promote analytics best practices and data-driven decision making across the business.

  • Bachelor's degree in quantitative field. Master’s degree preferred.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear business recommendations for executives and non-technical audiences.

  • Working knowledge of Python, R, or comparable analytics/programming languages.

Senior Electrical Designer | Power & Electrification Division

Philippines | Permanent Work From Home

  • Permanent work-from-home opportunity based in the Philippines, supporting major Australian energy projects.
  • Work across a diverse portfolio of wind, solar, BESS, transmission and HV substation projects.
  • Join a collaborative international team where your technical expertise will directly influence design quality and project outcomes.

The Opportunity

Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division partners with major energy developers and infrastructure clients to deliver large-scale renewable energy and power infrastructure projects across Australia. Based in the Philippines, you will work remotely as part of an integrated project team, contributing to greenfield developments and the upgrade and expansion of existing networks that support Australia's energy transition.

As a Senior Electrical Designer, you will play a key role in the design and delivery of Electrical Balance of Plant (EBOP) projects for wind farms, solar farms and BESS developments, while also supporting HV transmission and distribution infrastructure. You will collaborate virtually with experienced engineers and designers across Australia and the Philippines, gaining exposure to a broad range of technical disciplines and some of Australia's most significant energy projects.

This permanent work-from-home role offers exposure to HV substations, switchyards, underground and overhead reticulation systems, grid connection infrastructure and utility coordination activities. You will contribute to complex technical projects in a supportive team environment, with regular online collaboration across locations and time zones.

Please note: This position is open to candidates residing in the Philippines. The successful candidate will be employed locally through a third-party employment agency and will work exclusively with Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Deliver high-quality electrical design documentation for HV substations, utility infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
  • Develop primary design deliverables including equipment layouts, cable routing, earthing systems, conduit layouts and detailed construction drawings.
  • Support the successful coordination and delivery of multidisciplinary design packages to meet project and client requirements.
  • Contribute to HV and LV power system designs, equipment selection and technical solutions for complex energy infrastructure projects.
  • Collaborate with engineers and project teams to enhance design quality, project delivery and technical outcomes.
  • Help shape the delivery of renewable energy, transmission and power infrastructure projects that support Australia's evolving energy sector.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Designer based in the Philippines who is comfortable working remotely with Australian project teams, solving complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality outcomes across a diverse portfolio.

  • A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
  • 8+ years' experience within a design consultancy environment.
  • Strong experience in HV substation design and detailed design delivery using MicroStation and AutoCAD.
  • Experience delivering electrical engineering designs across renewable energy, transmission, substations, power generation, hydrogen, oil & gas or related energy sectors.
  • Proven capability undertaking LV and HV power generation and distribution systems design, including equipment selection such as transformers, circuit breakers and associated electrical infrastructure.
  • Experience completing HV and LV power system studies including load flow, short circuit, cable sizing, arc flash, discrimination and protection, earthing and harmonics assessments.
  • Proficiency using electrical modelling software such as ETAP, EMTP or PSCAD.
  • Strong understanding of relevant Australian Standards, including AS 2067, IEEE 80, AS/NZS 1768, AS 3000, AS 3008, IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-border team.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian projects or working to Australian Standards is highly regarded.

It would be great if you also have experience in High Voltage and Low Voltage Switchboard design in accordance with AS 61439 and exposure to instrumentation and control systems.

Why Fyfe?

Fyfe is an Australian multidisciplinary consultancy with more than 700 people across engineering, environment, planning and surveying. We partner with clients across the Energy & Resources and Property & Infrastructure sectors to deliver high-quality, commercially pragmatic solutions with a strong focus on client service and project delivery

Joining Fyfe from the Philippines means becoming a valued member of an international team, not an outsourced support function. Your expertise will have a genuine impact as you work on meaningful Australian energy projects and collaborate directly with experienced professionals across multiple disciplines.

Reasons to join Fyfe:

  • Permanent work-from-home arrangement from anywhere in the Philippines.
  • Direct involvement in major Australian renewable energy and power infrastructure projects.
  • Regular collaboration with experienced colleagues across Australia and the Philippines.
  • Competitive locally aligned remuneration and support for ongoing professional development.
  • An inclusive, technically strong workplace that values contribution, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

raw.excerpt: OverviewCherre is now a RealPage company, expanding our ability to deliver innovative data and technology solutions that transform the real estate industry.
raw.description:
Overview

Cherre is now a RealPage company, expanding our ability to deliver innovative data and technology solutions that transform the real estate industry. Join us as we build what’s next together.

Cherre is the leading real estate data management and analytics platform. We connect, resolve, and organize the fragmented data real estate organizations rely on: internal systems, public records, and third-party providers, into a single, connected source of truth. Institutional investors, asset managers, and brokers use Cherre to power underwriting, portfolio management, and reporting on data they can trust.

Our work sits at the intersection of real estate domain knowledge and modern data infrastructure, and this role is central to how we translate that platform into value for our most strategic clients.

Responsibilities

We're looking for a Senior Director of Solutions Architecture to lead the domain-first solutions engine of our sales and delivery motion. You'll own the presales function end to end, from first discovery call through handoff into delivery. You'll manage and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts, and you'll set the vision for how we scope, demonstrate, and win.

This role rests first on deep real assets domain expertise, complemented by technical acumen and a strong market-facing presence. You'll be credible discussing property operations and investment strategy with a client's leadership, guiding the solution alongside their data and engineering teams, and representing Cherre in front of a prospect's decision-makers. Domain fluency is the foundation; the ideal candidate pairs it with enough technical depth and executive presence to carry a solution from discovery through the deal.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll be in the room for our most strategic deals, shaping how we translate complex prospect requirements into compelling, credible solutions. Just as important, you'll be expected to modernize how the function operates. We want a leader who builds tools and AI-assisted workflows that make the team faster and sharper, not one who simply runs the existing playbook.

  • Lead the domain engine. Understand each client’s business deeply and align solutions to achieve their objectives.
  • Lead the presales function. Own the full presales lifecycle and partner closely with Sales to drive technical wins on strategic and enterprise opportunities.
  • Manage and develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Solution Architects and Business Analysts. Set standards, build expertise, balance workloads across active deals, and foster a culture of technical rigor.
  • Drive scoping and discovery. Personally lead scoping and discovery for strategic prospects, uncovering requirements, identifying risks, and defining solutions that map to real business outcomes.
  • Own the RFP process. Run the RFP response process end to end, ensuring responses are accurate, differentiated, and delivered on time.
  • Ensure clean handoffs to Delivery. Build and maintain a repeatable bridge from presales scoping into implementation so nothing is lost between the sale and the build.
  • Modernize the function with AI. Design and build skills and agentic workflows, and optimize the agentic fleet to streamline the process from scoping through delivery. Continuously identify ways to use AI to improve the quality and speed of the team’s output.
  • Represent the point of view. Publish, speak, and advocate for Cherre’s perspective on real assets data and semantic infrastructure, shaping how the market thinks about the problem—not just how Cherre solves it.
  • Close the loop into Product. Translate market and client signals from the field into product roadmap input, ensuring the roadmap reflects what the market is actually telling you—not just what has already been scoped.

Qualifications

  • Real assets domain expertise spanning the full stack: up into the capital stack (fund structures, debt and equity vehicles, investment vehicles) and down into the physical, operational asset (property operations, leasing, maintenance, tenant and resident experience). A track record of scoping and designing solutions that hold together across both ends of that stack, not just one.
  • Global and cross-asset-class experience: comfortable moving between multifamily, office, industrial, retail, and alternative asset classes, and across US, European, and APAC market conventions and regulatory contexts.
  • 10+ years in real estate, proptech, or consulting, with experience leading teams of domain and technical experts.
  • Technical fluency across entity resolution, graph-based data models, and semantic layer architecture, sufficient to guide solution and demo design and engage credibly with a client's data and engineering teams on how identity, confidence, and lineage actually work under the platform, not just what the platform outputs.
  • Fluent in the shift from human-readable reporting to typed, governed interfaces built for agent consumption: why a report could tolerate semantic drift that an agent reasoning from the same data cannot, and why that difference is now a product architecture problem, not a documentation problem.
  • Demonstrated thought leadership: a track record of publishing or speaking on real assets, data, or investment strategy, not just executing someone else's narrative.
  • Executive presence to represent Cherre externally, lead the room in strategic deals, and translate technical complexity into business value for institutional buyers.
  • The ability to operate as both a player and a coach: both getting hands-on in deals, and effective at hiring, developing, and leading a high-performing team behind you.
  • An AI-forward mindset, with hands-on experience building tools, automations, or agentic workflows.

Nice to have experience with:

  • AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT
  • Building AI agents and agentic workflows
  • Interacting with Github
  • Experience with knowledge management tools such as Obsidian

Pay Range

USD $190,000.00 - USD $235,000.00 /Yr.
